clauses.clause: When Barrin enters, return up to one other target creature or planeswalker to its owner's hand.
clauses.evidence: Every [cast] variant: 'ask target: [you_bear, you_giant, opp_flier, opp_tapped, opp_bear, opp_giant, NONE]': creatures of both sides, not Barrin itself ('other'), not the relic/charm, NONE allowed ('up to one'). The target goes to its OWNER's hand (you_bear -> your hand; opp_flier -> 'opp: hand 2 -> 3'); NONE returns nothing. The planeswalker half is unseen (no planeswalker on the board): pack barrin_bounces_opponents_planeswalker_no_draw (the opponent's Basri Ket returns to the opponent's hand) PASS. Canonical B2a-barrin-etb.

clauses.clause: At the beginning of your end step, if a permanent was put into your hand from the battlefield this turn, draw a card.
clauses.evidence: [cast] bouncing you_bear or you_giant: 'after the turn ends: + you:Library 5#1 (hand, you)', 'you: hand 6 -> 7' (one draw). Bouncing an opponent's creature or choosing NONE: no draw at the end step. Turn-pass stimulus (nothing returned): trigger [1] is reported but no extra card is drawn (hand 5 -> 6 is the draw step). Packs: barrin_any_permanent_to_your_hand_draws (your artifact returned by another effect: one draw) PASS; barrin_your_end_step_this_turn_only (returned on the opponent's turn: no draw at their end step nor at your next end step) PASS; barrin_bounces_opponents_planeswalker_no_draw (to the opponent's hand: no draw) PASS. Canonical B2a-barrin-end-step.
clauses.issue: The engine reports the trigger even when the intervening 'if' is false and suppresses the effect instead (CR 603.4 says it does not trigger); outcome identical. MOVED_TO_ZONE_THIS_TURN's from_zone is Zone(BATTLEFIELD, YOU), so a card you own but an opponent controlled might not count: weaker-only edge.
